cells.depends: Go standard library; explicitly selected low-level libraries
cells.rule: Root never imports admin, async or concrete connectors. Proposed module path must match publishing repository before release.

cells.depends: Other public Core packages under a checked acyclic dependency graph
cells.public: app, conf, management, checks, models, orm, db, migrations, http, urls, views, api, pagination, auth, sessions, security, forms, templates, cache, ratelimit, files, mail, messages, i18n, signals, testing, telemetry, health, contrib
cells.rule: No separate module per tiny package. Interfaces belong to consuming Core capability, not private internal packages.

cells.public: Site, ModelAdmin, Inline, Action, widgets, audit and extension hooks
cells.rule: Own go.mod and embedded assets; own admin/internal. Tag admin/vX.Y.Z; omission adds no Admin routes/assets.

cells.public: Task, Signature, Canvas, Worker, Scheduler, Broker, ResultStore and schedule contracts
cells.rule: Own go.mod and async/internal. Tag async/vX.Y.Z; no Redis dependency in task contract module.

cells.public: Connector, Dialect, Introspector, SchemaEditor, PostgreSQL fields/functions
cells.rule: Own internal implementation; tag connectors/postgres/vX.Y.Z. Database connector does not import Admin or Async.

cells.public: Client, Cache, SessionStore, RateLimiter and Lock provider
cells.rule: No task runtime dependency. Tag connectors/redis/vX.Y.Z; explicit separate clients for logical roles.

cells.public: Broker, Results, SchedulerStore and coordination adapters
cells.rule: Integration module avoids a Redis-to-Async dependency cycle; tag async/redis/vX.Y.Z.

cells.path: internal/ and each nested module's internal/
cells.rule: SQL compiler, registry builders, template compiler, code generation and migration graph internals. Optional modules consume public APIs only.

cells.public: Architecture review; contributor tests; executable examples; release scripts
cells.rule: Tooling roots are not exported Go API. Do not create backend/frontend directories for this library.

cells.depends: Released versions still declared in each go.mod
cells.rule: CI tests GOWORK=off per module. No absolute-path replacements in release modules. Examples must also compile outside go.work.

cells.depends: Pin compatible versions and publish release matrix
cells.public: Semantic import versioning, migration/task payload/schema versions
cells.rule: v0 until contract stabilizes. v2+ use /v2 path in each module. No forced lockstep version except tested compatibility constraints.

summary: Proposed contract for architecture review; not implemented.
